description: PSSCOC Construction Works 2020 with option modules. Contract period instead of a completion date, LD cap, advance payment, fluctuation materials, one amended clause (oral instruction confirmation), an RFA procedure. Deliberately absent: completion date (must not be computed), claim day of month ("last working day" is not a number), final account period and others.
